correctness.rationale: From the actual geodesic distances on K_{n,n} minus a perfect matching, the full powered matrix has diagonal blocks 2^p(J-I) and off-diagonal blocks J+(3^p-1)I. The exact constant and three centered invariant eigenspaces yield eigenvalues (n-1)(2^p-1)-3^p (once), 3^p-2^p-1 (n-1 times), 1-2^p-3^p (n-1 times). Independently constructed exact 2n-by-2n metric matrices and checked every specified sector vector for n=3,4,6,10 and p=1,2; all identities agree. Subadditivity forces p<=1; 3^p/(2^p-1) strictly decreases on (0,1], yielding beta=1 for n3,4 and unique root (n-1)(2^p-1)=3^p for n>=5. Eigenvalue zero multiplicities give endpoint ranks 3,3,2n-2. Series inversion yields second-order expansion and gain relative to Sanchez K_n,n formula; Schoenberg CND iff e^{-tD} PSD for every t>0. Finite checks are not infinite proof.
